content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments enable digital creators to transact directly with customers using cryptocurrency. This method not only reduces dependency on traditional payment processors but also significantly lowers fees. For instance, while Gumroad takes 10% on every sale, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. This fee difference means that for 100 sales of a $97 product, a creator retains an additional $921. Understanding this model is crucial for creators looking to maximize their earnings and retain control over their sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Solana payments combines multiple components to create a seamless selling experience. At the core, you have NOWPayments for processing transactions. When a customer purchases a digital product, payment is confirmed on-chain, and the product is automatically delivered using services like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This infrastructure ensures that creators maintain complete ownership of their data and products, without reliance on third-party platforms. The integration of low-cost networks like Solana also enables instant transactions, making the buying process quick and efficient.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment solutions are not viable. It empowers creators in countries like Kenya, Ghana, and Venezuela to sell ebooks, courses, and digital assets without facing the limitations of mainstream platforms. By implementing Solana payments, these creators can operate independently, avoid high fees, and enhance their revenue potential. This approach levels the playing field, allowing creators everywhere to monetize their work effectively.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of using Solana payments lies in its integrated components. First, you utilize NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transaction processing. Next, you employ Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend automation, which handles order fulfillment and product delivery. Combining these tools with a decentralized storage solution like Google Drive allows for efficient management of digital assets. This stack creates a robust infrastructure that not only supports secure transactions but also ensures that creators maintain sovereignty over their content and revenue.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling with Solana payments, first, set up your digital storefront using the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides the necessary blueprints and templates to get you started. Next, integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing, ensuring you select Solana for lower transaction fees. Finally, configure your product delivery system with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for seamless customer experiences. By following these steps, you can quickly deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize cryptocurrency payments through NOWPayments. This allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies, reducing reliance on traditional platforms and their fees. You'll need to set up a digital storefront and integrate a payment processor like NOWPayments to handle transactions effectively.
With Solana payments, you maintain complete ownership of your digital products.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) which includes everything you need to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack. This approach connects you to global customers without the restrictions of traditional payment methods, allowing you to leverage crypto payments effectively.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by using cryptocurrency payments through NOWPayments. This allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies directly, eliminating the need for traditional payment processors.

The best way to avoid platform fees is by utilizing NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This significantly reduces costs compared to traditional platforms like Gumroad, allowing you to retain more revenue.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own digital storefront and integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This method gives you full control without relying on platforms like Gumroad.
What are the advantages of using Solana for payments?

Using Solana for payments offers low transaction fees and fast processing times. This makes it an ideal choice for digital creators looking to maximize their profits while ensuring quick delivery of their products.
How can I ensure my digital products are delivered automatically?

You can ensure automatic delivery of your digital products by implementing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools automate order fulfillment, providing customers with instant access to their purchases.
Automated delivery systems streamline customer transactions and enhance user experience.
